title: KTO: Model Alignment as Prospect Theoretic Optimization
authors_zh: Kawin Ethayarajh、Winnie Xu、Niklas Muennighoff、Dan Jurafsky、Douwe Kiela（斯坦福大学、Contextual AI）
paper_type_zh: 二元反馈驱动的偏好优化与语言模型对齐研究
best_for_zh: 适合理解弱监督反馈如何替代成对偏好、并直接进入模型对齐训练的读者。
one_line: KTO directly aligns a policy from desirable and undesirable response labels using a prospect-theoretic objective.
KTO 将逐条回答的好/坏二元反馈直接转化为基于前景理论的对齐目标，避免要求同一提示下的成对偏好。
why: It changes the minimal feedback record required by a direct alignment trainer from a pair to an independently labeled response.
inclusion_reason: Establishes a direct alignment objective that consumes independent desirable/undesirable feedback rather than requiring paired preferences.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Many alignment objectives assume that feedback arrives as a preferred and rejected response for the same prompt. Such paired data is costly to obtain and discards the far more common operational signal that an individual response is simply acceptable or unacceptable.

KTO asks whether an alignment objective can consume those binary judgments without reconstructing preference pairs. The intended change is to make the training objective fit the available feedback record, rather than requiring data collection to imitate the format expected by an existing optimizer.

许多对齐目标都假定反馈以同一提示下的优选回答和拒选回答成对到达。这样的成对数据收集成本高，也忽略了实际系统中更常见的信号：单个回答只是被判断为可接受或不可接受。

KTO 要回答的是，对齐目标能否直接使用这些二元判断，而不必重新拼出偏好对。它希望改变的是训练目标与可获得反馈记录之间的关系，而不是要求数据采集去模仿既有优化器所期待的格式。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper interprets successful alignment losses as human-aware losses: objectives whose shape reflects reference-dependent gains, losses, and diminishing sensitivity. It then derives Kahneman-Tversky Optimization from a prospect-theoretic utility model, optimizing the utility of a generation rather than the likelihood of a preference comparison.

Each record is a prompt, a response, and a desirable or undesirable label. This makes binary approval data a first-class training input, while a batch-level estimate of a reference point preserves a constraint against indiscriminately increasing or decreasing every response probability.

论文将有效的对齐损失解释为“人类感知损失”：其形状反映了相对于参照点的收益、损失和边际敏感度递减。随后，它从前景理论的效用模型中推导出 Kahneman-Tversky 优化，直接优化一次生成的效用，而不是优化偏好比较的似然。

每条记录由提示、回答以及“理想”或“不理想”标签构成。这使二元认可数据成为一等训练输入；同时，批次级的参照点估计约束模型，避免它不加区分地提高或降低所有回答的概率。

title: Method
方法
html:
KTO converts preference datasets by treating chosen outputs as desirable and rejected outputs as undesirable, and it can also use naturally binary feedback. Its loss uses separate weights for desirable and undesirable examples and estimates a KL-related reference point by pairing prompts with mismatched responses inside a microbatch.

The experiments compare KTO with DPO, supervised fine-tuning, SLiC, conditional SFT, and an offline PPO variant. They use Anthropic-HH, OpenAssistant, and SHP data, evaluate model families from roughly 1B to 30B parameters, and test both closed-ended tasks and judged open-ended generations.

KTO 将偏好数据集转换为二元记录：把被选中的输出视为理想输出，把被拒绝的输出视为不理想输出；它也可以直接使用天然的二元反馈。其损失对两类样本采用不同权重，并通过在微批次内把提示与不匹配回答配对，估计一个与 KL 相关的参照点。

实验将 KTO 与 DPO、监督微调、SLiC、条件监督微调和离线 PPO 变体比较。作者使用 Anthropic-HH、OpenAssistant 和 SHP 数据，考察约 10 亿到 300 亿参数的模型家族，并同时测试封闭式任务和需要评判的开放式生成。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across the reported 1B-to-30B experiments, KTO matches or exceeds the compared preference-based methods despite receiving only binary desirability signals. The paper also reports that KTO can tolerate strong class imbalance, including settings with far fewer desirable than undesirable examples.

These findings support the claim that pair structure is not always necessary for effective alignment. They do not show that any binary label is sufficient in every deployment: performance remains sensitive to learning rate, model scale, the desirable-to-undesirable ratio, and the assumptions used when converting pairwise data.

在论文报告的 10 亿到 300 亿参数实验中，KTO 仅接收二元理想性信号，却能达到或超过所比较的偏好方法。论文还报告，KTO 能够容忍明显的类别不平衡，包括理想样本远少于不理想样本的设定。

这些发现支持了一个主张：要实现有效对齐，偏好对结构并非总是必要。不过，它们并不说明任何二元标签在所有部署中都足够有效；性能仍会受到学习率、模型规模、两类样本比例以及把成对数据转换为二元数据时所作假设的影响。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier direct preference objectives make the comparison between a winner and loser the primitive training event. KTO instead elevates the individual labeled response to that role, while retaining a principled reference-dependent loss rather than falling back to ordinary positive-only supervised fine-tuning.

The novelty is consequently both conceptual and operational. Prospect theory motivates the asymmetric treatment of good and bad feedback, and the resulting objective changes what annotators or automated judges need to emit for an example to become usable by the trainer.

较早的直接偏好目标把胜出回答与落选回答之间的比较当作基本训练事件。KTO 则把单条已标注回答提升为基本单位，同时保留有理论依据的、依赖参照点的损失，而不是退回到普通的仅正样本监督微调。

因此，它的新意同时具有概念和操作层面的意义。前景理论为理想与不理想反馈的不对称处理提供了动机，得到的目标也改变了标注者或自动评审器必须输出什么，才能让一条样本可被训练器使用。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The reference-point estimate is intentionally biased for convenience and adds an extra forward pass, while the method is sensitive to optimization settings. Converting chosen and rejected answers into independent binary examples also assumes that their labels remain meaningful without the original within-prompt comparison; that assumption may fail for ambiguous or context-dependent judgments.
为方便计算，参照点估计被有意设为有偏，并会增加一次前向计算；该方法也对优化设置敏感。把优选和拒选回答转换为独立二元样本，还假定脱离原始的同提示比较后，这些标签依然有意义；对于含糊或高度依赖上下文的判断，这一假定可能不成立。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use KTO when feedback is naturally logged as approvals, rejections, safety flags, or scalar ratings that can be thresholded, rather than as matched response pairs. It is particularly useful for deciding whether a data-collection system should preserve pair construction costs or emit independently labeled generations for a direct alignment objective.
当反馈天然记录为认可、拒绝、安全标记，或可阈值化的标量评分，而不是配对回答时，可使用 KTO。它尤其适合帮助判断：数据采集系统是否需要承担构造偏好对的成本，还是应当输出能被直接对齐目标使用的独立标注生成结果。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the data-conversion assumptions together with the ablations on imbalance, model scale, and SFT initialization. For an implementation, verify the microbatch construction, the desirable and undesirable weights, the KL-reference estimate, and the learning-rate range; these details determine whether the promised flexibility of binary feedback survives optimization.
应将数据转换假设与关于类别不平衡、模型规模和监督微调初始化的消融实验一并阅读。实现时要核验微批次的构成、理想与不理想样本的权重、KL 参照点估计和学习率范围；这些细节决定了二元反馈所承诺的灵活性能否在优化过程中保留下来。
